charts.title: TOI-1422 c: orbits around TOI-1422
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1422's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1422 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Naponiello et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.545f2030N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NAPONIELLO_ET_AL_2026): P 34.5633 d

charts.title: TOI-1422 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1422 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (17, 57, 84) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 333473672, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 28 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 36 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 24-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 28 min early; 24-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 12 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
